market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Oil shock and 5% 10-year yield cap equity upside. AI volatility creates whipsaw. Fed meeting this week is binary catalyst. Expect S&P 500 range-bound 5,800-6,200 with elevated VIX. Energy outperforms; tech and consumer lag.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex cycle (Anthropic $2T, Nvidia, Broadcom) supports 12-month earnings growth. Tariff realignment (Brazil, Ireland) reduces trade friction. Korea chip cycle and China soybean deal provide EM support. Key risk: if oil stays elevated >$100, stagflation risk rises.
